Goodbye, Los Santos.

Welcome to Vice City.

A first look at a GTA 6’s physical code-in-a-box edition 

It includes a double-sided A3 poster (via MediaMarktSaturn & GTAforums)

Vice City Fest

GTA 6 : J-10

Pre-téléchargement : Disponible à minuit

Basé sur le créneau français 🇫🇷
The new GTA 6 artwork fits perfectly as a wallpaper.

Rockstar has announced ‘Grand Theft Auto 6: The Festival’ on November 21 in Miami

Artists include Travis Scott, Kodak Black, Justice, Metro Boomin, and Cardi B

New GTA 6 details:

- Download size is 209.9GB
- The game has a shared base, with story and online (later) being separate
- Japanese version is missing a 1.37GB file
- New Zealand and Australia versions are missing a 0.688MB file
- Rest of the world have the same version
-
Très bonne semaine à tous ! (dernière semaine avant GTA VI 👀)

Un festival GTA VI à Miami le 21 novembre, deux jours après la sortie du jeu.

Travis Scott, Cardi B, Justice, Metro Boomin, CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, Tainy.

Les places se jouent à la loterie. Elle ferme demain 22h, heure de Paris.

Ex-Rockstar dev Obbe Vermeij believes there will be an AI-assisted PC port of GTA 6 before the official release

“I wouldn’t be surprised if there was an effort to get [the releases] a little bit closer together”
